title: DexMimic: A Generalist Dexterous Hand-Object Tracking Policy via Value-Guided Reset Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19089v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Achieving human-like dexterous manipulation remains a central challenge in robotics. Learning from human hand-object interaction (HOI) datasets offers a promising pathway to diverse dexterous skills, yet existing physics-based approaches train specialist policies for individual trajectories, thereby limiting skill reuse at scale. We introduce DexMimic, a generalist dexterous hand-object tracking policy jointly trained across diverse HOI trajectories. Efficient joint training requires allocating each rollout to both an undertrained phase and a starting state that supports continued tracking. DexMimic realizes this insight through Value-Guided Reset Allocation, which adapts the initialization distribution online to prioritize difficult phases and select reset states with higher expected tracking returns. We further introduce a benchmark spanning training, fine-tuning, and generalization. Experiments show improved tracking success

translated_title: DexMimic：基于价值引导重置分配的通用灵巧手-物体跟踪策略
translated_abstract: 实现类人的灵巧操作仍然是机器人学中的核心挑战。从人手-物体交互（HOI）数据集中学习为实现多样化灵巧技能提供了一条有前景的路径，然而现有的基于物理的方法针对单条轨迹训练专用策略，从而限制了技能的大规模复用。我们提出了DexMimic，这是一个在多样化HOI轨迹上联合训练的通用灵巧手-物体跟踪策略。高效的联合训练需要将每次 rollout 分配到训练不足的阶段，并分配到一个支持持续跟踪的起始状态。DexMimic 通过价值引导重置分配来实现这一洞察，该方法在线调整初始化分布，以优先处理困难阶段并选择具有更高预期跟踪回报的重置状态。我们进一步引入了一个涵盖训练、微调和泛化测试的基准。实验表明跟踪成功率有所提升。
tldr: 提出了DexMimic——一个通过价值引导重置分配机制、在多样化人手-物体交互轨迹上联合训练的通用灵巧手跟踪策略，实现了技能的大规模复用并显著提升了跟踪成功率。
en_tdlr: DexMimic introduces a generalist dexterous hand-object tracking policy jointly trained across diverse HOI trajectories, using Value-Guided Reset Allocation to online-adapt reset distributions toward difficult phases and high-return states, enabling large-scale skill reuse and improved tracking success.
